useCase: Brand partner analytics portal giving restaurant and CPG brands row-level-secured visibility into their DoorDash sales performance, category trends, and AI-powered insights. Each brand sees only their own data, scoped by country via ThoughtSpot RLS formula variables.
sampleQuestions: What are my top-selling items this quarter?
How does my country performance compare month over month?
Which regions are showing the most growth?
rlsRules: dd_Country formula variable scopes data by country. Each user is assigned one or more country values; the liveboard and search queries filter to exactly those countries at query time.
